description: Change of use from single dwelling house (Use Class C3) to residential Institution (Use Class C2). (RETROSPECTIVE).
decision_conditions: 2.	Approved PlansThe development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Location Plan, dated 15 June 2026Pre - Existing Plans, ref: 26-1103-101A, dated September 2026Pre - Existing Elevations, ref: 26-1103-102A, dated September 2026Existing Plans, ref: 26-1103-103A, dated September 2026Existing Elevations, ref: 26-1103-104A, dated September 2026Design and Access Statement, dated June 2026Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

Use ClassesThe premises shall be used only as a children's care home for up to four (4) children and for no other purpose, including any other purpose within Class C2 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (as amended), or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order, without the prior written permission of the Local Planning Authority.Reason: In the interests of residential amenity, car parking and highway safety, having regard to Policies DMD8 and DMD45 of the Enfield Development Management Document.

Number of OccupantsThe development hereby permitted shall be occupied by no more than four (4) residents and two (2) members of staff (excluding ad hoc visiting specialists/ therapists) at any one time.Reason: In the interests of residential amenity, car parking and highway safety, having regard to Policies DMD8 and DMD45 of the Enfield Development Management Document.

Cycle ParkingWithin 3 months of the date of the decision notice, details of the 1 long-stay and 1 short-stay cycle parking spaces shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. These details should demonstrate: Location: Near entrances or main access Design: Stands or wall bars Security: Secure, overlooked, well-lit Coverage: Covered Accessibility: Step-free, no obstructionsThe cycle parking spaces shall be fully constructed in accordance with the approved details prior to first occupation and shall thereafter be retained for the lifetime of the development. Reason: To ensure that adequate cycle parking facilities are provided to promote sustainable modes of transport.

Refuse Within 3 months of the date of this decision notice, details of waste storage and recycling facilities to satisfy the future number of occupiers on site shall be provided and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, within the development, in accordance with the Enfield's Household Recycling and Waste Planning Guidance for New Developments (February 2024). Such facilities to be retained for the lifetime of the development.Reason: To ensure that adequate waste and recycling storage facilities are provided to meet the needs of future occupiers, promote sustainable waste management practices, and support borough-wide recycling targets.

Means of EnclosureWithin 3 months of the date of this decision notice, details of the means of enclosure for vehicles, pedestrians, and cyclists shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The enclosures shall be fully constructed in accordance with the approved details prior to first occupation and shall thereafter be retained for the lifetime of the development. Reason: To ensure a safe, secure, and accessible environment for all users of the development, including vehicles, pedestrians, and cyclists, and to maintain the visual quality and functionality of the site.
